sample_unit: core clinical inquiries (31 subtopics) rated by 6 wound care nurses

links.outcome: Scientific accuracy of ChatGPT-4 answers on diabetic foot ulcer protocols versus current IWGDF 2023 guidelines
links.effect: Scientific accuracy declined to 6.67/10 for formal clinical protocols, particularly IWGDF 2023 updates, while clarity scored 152/155; experts showed high consensus (ICC = 0.937).
links.quote: However, a significant decline in scientific accuracy was observed when addressing formal clinical protocols (6.67/10), particularly regarding the International Working Group on the Diabetic Foot (IWGDF) 2023 updates.

screen.reason: Expert wound care nurses evaluated the clarity and accuracy of ChatGPT-4 responses to diabetic foot ulcer management queries. It evaluates model accuracy and clarity offline without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
